assumptions: A-1  Cost Allocation overhead pool = Cost Summary total_business_overheads (map s6/s7: overhead_absorbed_cost). Support-asset cost is in the Cost Summary burden but is NOT in the pool or in any group unless a support asset is assigned.

A-2  group_recovery_hours when asset hours drive: MIN(required_asset_hours, labour hours) if any labour is assigned (map s7, CM-9); with no labour assigned the MAX of the asset hours (the map does not say; not exercised by Scenario A).

A-3  Business Outcome asset-row overhead share uses SUM of the group's asset-row hours as the denominator (map s9.2 says 'group asset hours'; Cost Allocation's own assigned_asset_hours is the MAX, which would over-allocate). Settled by Scenario A group G02 (two assets, sequential).

A-4  The inner (per-source) cascade starts from each row's net profit LESS its non-productive share, and its shortfall is the group's outer deduction (naive group profit - final group profit). Map s9.5 says 'same two phases inside each group'.
A-5  Cascade boundary nodes (real_capacity_a/b.cascade) are read as the shortfall each cascade absorbs. Inferred from the snapshot (0 and 0.01), not stated by the map.

A-6  View A materials: revenue = real revenue - labour modelled - asset modelled (residual); true cost = COGS + max(business overheads - overhead assigned to groups, 0); profit floored at 0. View B materials is a peer at COGS x (1 + markup). Row modelled revenue is floored at 0 (CONFIRMED live 2026-10-17, misaligned A; owner decision F-5); the shortfall uses the unfloored residual.
